title: Nursing and Billing Bulletin: Care Increase on Re-Leveled Nights Before the Assessment Date
content:
On a level-change segment of an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, re-leveled nights that fall before the nurse assessment carry only a share of the care increase.

**Pre-assessment nights.** Pre-assessment nights are the re-leveled nights that fall before the level effective date on the stay, that is the re-leveled nights less the nights from the level effective date through the last night of the segment that was credited, both counted, and never fewer than none. The segment that was credited is the stay's latest nightly charge segment.

**Share.** The pre-assessment share of the care increase is one half (0.5) when there are three or more pre-assessment nights, three quarters (0.75) when there are one or two, and the whole increase (1) when there are none.

**Effect.** On each pre-assessment night only the pre-assessment share of the care increase is billed: for each pre-assessment night, the part of its care increase that the share leaves unbilled is taken off the nights on which the care increase is billed — one half of a night for each pre-assessment night at a one-half share, one quarter of a night for each at a three-quarters share, nothing when there are no pre-assessment nights.

## Share by count

| Pre-assessment nights | Share of the care increase billed on each | Care-increase nights taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Whole increase (1) | None |
| 1 | Three quarters (0.75) | 0.25 |
| 2 | Three quarters (0.75) | 0.5 |
| 3 | One half (0.5) | 1.5 |
| 4 | One half (0.5) | 2 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical stay; last night of the segment that was credited 14 May)

| Re-leveled nights | Level effective date | Nights from the effective date through 14 May | Pre-assessment nights | Care-increase nights taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 5 May | 10 | 4 | 4 times one half, that is 2 |
| 12 | 2 May | 13 | none (12 less 13 is below none) | none |
| 11 | 5 May | 10 | 1 | one quarter |

In the first case, with a care increase of 45.00 per night, the care increase is billed on 2 nights fewer, 90.00 less in total than if every re-leveled night carried the whole increase.
